title: Where praise makes death keep its distance
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: This shabad opens inside the place where the Holy keep singing the Lord's praises. It turns the heart toward a sanctuary even fear and death do not rule.
whyItMatters: This matters when speech has turned sharp, anxious, or spiritually thin. The shabad shows that praise changes the whole atmosphere a life is spoken inside.
takeaway: Keep company with praise until fear stops ruling the room.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeh saadhoo gobidh bhajan keeratan naanak neet ||
lines.translation: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O Nanak

lines.gurmukhi: ਣਾ ਹਉ ਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa hau naa too(n) neh chhuTeh nikaT na jaieeahu dhoot ||1||
lines.translation: - the Righteous Judge says, ""Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!""||1||

structure: The shabad begins by placing the seeker inside a living atmosphere of kirtan.
From there it shows that holy speech becomes protection, not ornament.
The closing movement rests by depicting a place even death is told not to approach.
